name: Kelsian Group Limited
summary: Kelsian Group Limited provides land and marine transport, and tourism services in Australia, Singapore, the United Kingdom, and the United States. It operates through four segments: Marine and Tourism, Australian Bus, International Bus, and Corporate. The company offers vehicle and passenger ferry services, barging, coach tours and package holidays, lunch, dinner, charter cruises, and accommodation facilities. It also operates metropolitan public bus services; regional and remote bus services; and charter bus services.
